name: impact_analysis
description: BEFORE modifying a function/class: see all callers (blast radius), callees, risk level. For line-level, use call_chain.

workspace_dir.description: REQUIRED: Absolute path to the project root directory. Call reindex first if this is a new workspace.

file.description: File path relative to workspace_dir (e.g. "scripts/lib/tools/spawn.mjs", not the full absolute path)

symbol.description: Symbol name (function, class, method, variable) to analyze. When provided, does symbol-level analysis. When omitted, does file-level analysis (all symbols in the file).

change_type.description: Change type. Affects risk threshold (default: modify)

max_callers.description: Max callers to return (default: 20). caller_count always includes full counts.

depth.description: Indirect caller BFS depth (default: 2, max: 10). Only used when symbol is provided.
